data.name: Aguste
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word augere, meaning 'to increase'. The name Aguste was borne by several early Christian saints, including St. Augustine of Hippo, a renowned philosopher and theologian whose writings greatly influenced Western Christianity. The name signifies one who is majestic, revered, and venerable.

Although not commonly used as a given name today, the name Aguste retains a sense of majesty and respect in cultural contexts.
